backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for EcoPowerHub AI that implements access control, user profiles, system configuration, energy data management, Stripe integration, and various IoT/energy device features on the Internet Computer.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each React component, page, and hook in the application.
frontend/.env.pinata.example: Example environment file template for Pinata IPFS API credentials, requiring PINATA_JWT and optionally PINATA_GATEWAY.
frontend/dist/.ic-assets.json5: ICP asset canister configuration defining cache-control headers, MIME types, SPA fallback routing, and security policies for various file types in the deployed frontend.
frontend/dist/index.html: Built HTML entry point for EcoPowerHub AI with full SEO metadata, Open Graph tags, PWA configuration, structured data schema, and hreflang tags for internationalization.
frontend/docs/build-optimization-notes.m: Documents post-optimization build changes including duplicate key fixes, React.lazy code splitting for non-initial routes, and Vite manual chunk configuration for vendor libraries.
frontend/docs/pinata-pinning.md: Guide for uploading files to IPFS using the Pinata SDK, covering prerequisites, environment variable setup, and usage instructions.
frontend/index.html: Source HTML entry point for the Vite-built frontend with SEO metadata, PWA manifest, Open Graph/Twitter cards, structured data, and a root div for the React app.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: ICP custom domain verification file listing ecopowerhub.ai and www.ecopowerhub.ai as the canister's custom domains.
frontend/public/generated/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to keep the generated assets directory tracked in git.
frontend/public/generated/GENERATION_GUI: Detailed specifications for generating 57 PNG assets for EcoPowerHub AI, including dimensions, visual style, color palette, and per-asset design instructions across categories like branding, device logos, and setup guides.
frontend/public/generated/STYLE-GUIDE.tx: Visual style reference for EcoPowerHub AI defining the color palette, typography, design element rules, and asset requirements (logos, dashboards, avatars) with optimization and accessibility guidelines.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest for EcoPowerHub AI specifying app metadata, icons, display mode, and shortcuts to the Dashboard and Diagnostics pages.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt that allows general crawling but disallows access to dashboard, domains, email-automation, and deployment-status paths, and references the sitemap.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker (v128.1) implementing network-first caching for navigation and HTML, cache-first for static assets, and network-first for JS/CSS, with install-time precaching and old-cache cleanup on activation.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing all public EcoPowerHub AI URLs with priorities, change frequencies, and hreflang alternates for English, German, French, Hindi, and Spanish.
frontend/restore-assets.js: Node.js script that verifies all required PNG assets are present in frontend/public/generated/, creating the directory if needed and maintaining a complete inventory of expected filenames and dimensions.
frontend/scripts/pinata-fs-utils.mjs: ES module providing deterministic, alphabetically sorted file discovery for a directory tree, plus helpers for retrieving file size and formatting bytes as a human-readable string.
frontend/scripts/pinata-pin.mjs: Node.js script that recursively pins files from a given directory to IPFS using the Pinata SDK, generating a manifest of file paths to CIDs. Requires PINATA_JWT environment variable and optionally PINATA_GATEWAY.
frontend/scripts/resend-ecopowerhub-logo: Reads the 1024x1024 monochrome-dark EcoPowerHub logo PNG, Base64-encodes it, and outputs one of four equal slices (specified by CLI argument) to stdout without a trailing newline.
Reads the 1024x1024 monochrome-white EcoPowerHub logo PNG, Base64-encodes it, and outputs one of four equal slices (specified by CLI argument) to stdout without a trailing newline.
Reads the 1024x1024 full-color EcoPowerHub emblem PNG, Base64-encodes it, and outputs one of four equal slices (specified by CLI argument) to stdout without a trailing newline.
frontend/scripts/verify-no-deprecated-pi: Scans frontend and backend source files for deprecated Pinata API calls (e.g., pinata.upload.folder) and exits with an error if any are found, enforcing use of the modern SDK.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the React application's router, query client, and route tree using TanStack Router and React Query, with lazy-loaded page components and an AppLayout wrapper that handles authentication state and profile setup.
frontend/src/components/affiliate/SolarG: Displays affiliate marketing cards for solar generator brands (EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery) with product details, tracking IDs, app features, and CTA links.
frontend/src/components/affiliate/Tracki: Small UI component that displays an affiliate tracking ID with a clipboard copy button and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/AlarmNotificatio: A modal overlay component that displays a morning update (weather, energy summary, efficiency) when an alarm triggers, plays an alarm sound on mount, and supports text-to-speech readout via a speak button.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: A React class-based error boundary that catches unhandled render errors and displays a fallback UI with options to reload the page or navigate home.
frontend/src/components/AraChat.tsx: A floating chat widget that simulates a support assistant named Ara by responding to user messages with random pre-written helpful tips.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AddAla: A dialog component for creating a new morning alarm, collecting wake-up time, ringtone, alert beep, language, and active status, then submitting via the useAddAlarmConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AddSys: A dialog component for adding a new energy system configuration (HVAC, etc.) with fields for system ID, API endpoint, auth token, brand, and region, auto-detecting region from the browser and submitting via useAddSystemConfig.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Alarms: A dashboard tab that lists all configured morning alarms with options to toggle active state, edit, or delete each alarm, and opens AddAlarmDialog or EditAlarmDialog as needed.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Analyt: A dashboard tab displaying energy consumption analytics with an area chart of historical and predicted data, a report download feature, and deployment URL/DNS/SSL status indicators.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/EditAl: A dialog component for editing an existing alarm configuration, allowing users to update wake-up time, ring tone, alert beep, language, and active status via a form that submits changes through the updateAlarmConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Energy: A responsive dual-axis line chart component that visualizes energy consumption (kWh) and temperature (°C) over time using Recharts, accepting an array of EnergyData as props.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/EVAuth: A dialog for connecting a Ford or Rivian EV via a mock OAuth flow, collecting a vehicle ID and storing the resulting OAuth config via useAddEVOAuthConfig.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Mainte: A dashboard tab that displays system health status, service statuses, and maintenance metrics fetched via useGetMaintenanceDashboard, with color-coded indicators and a manual refresh button.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/MyEVCa: A card component displaying EV telemetry data (battery level, range, charging status) for a connected Ford or Rivian vehicle, with buttons to initiate solar charging or disconnect the vehicle.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Overvi: A dashboard overview tab that displays summary stats (total energy, average temperature, active systems) along with an energy chart, temperature gauge, and system status cards, with loading skeletons and an onboarding prompt when no systems exist.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Recomm: A dashboard tab that fetches and displays AI-powered energy optimization recommendations filtered by the user's preferred language, showing badges, timestamps, and a summary alert about potential consumption reduction.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/System: Dashboard tab component that displays connected energy systems and EV integrations (Ford/Rivian), allowing users to add systems and connect/disconnect EV accounts via dialogs.
A grid of cards displaying the latest energy consumption and temperature data for each connected system, showing a placeholder message when no systems are configured.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Temper: Bar chart component using Recharts that visualizes temperature data per location, supporting both Celsius and Fahrenheit display.
frontend/src/components/diagnostics/Smar: Diagnostics panel that fetches and displays automated device health diagnostic events with quality badges and icons (good/bad/uncertain), including loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A simple footer component displaying copyright info and links to caffeine.ai and EcoPowerHub.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky app header showing the EcoPowerHub logo, logged-in user greeting, theme toggle, and logout button, with responsive desktop and mobile (sheet drawer) navigation.
frontend/src/components/LoadingErrorBoun: A functional wrapper component that shows a loading spinner, a timeout error, or a network error UI with a retry button based on loading/error state and online connectivity.
Renders the marketing site footer with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, and legal links for EcoPowerHub AI.
Sticky marketing site header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation, theme toggle, and dropdowns for region and language selection with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name and preferred language, auto-detecting browser language, then saving the profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/RouteErrorFallba: Error boundary fallback UI that displays an error message with options to navigate home, retry, or reload the page.
frontend/src/components/StableImage.tsx: Image component that prevents flickering during re-renders by showing a placeholder while loading and gracefully falling back to a fallback source or an error UI on failure.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend interactions, covering user profiles, system configs, energy data, diagnostics, EV OAuth, and more.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that configures Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens, plus utility styles for grid backgrounds and image loading states.
frontend/src/lib/alarmService.ts: Provides alarm-related utilities including motivational message generation, alarm sound playback via Web Audio API, and text-to-speech morning energy/weather updates using the SpeechSynthesis API.
frontend/src/lib/assetRestoration.ts: Documents and exports metadata for all 58 required PNG assets (filenames, dimensions, purpose, usage) used across the application, serving as a reference for build validation scripts.
frontend/src/lib/assetVerification.ts: Defines a categorized list of all required generated asset paths and provides runtime verification utilities to check asset accessibility via HTTP HEAD requests.
frontend/src/lib/generatedAssetPaths.ts: Exports a centralized constant map of all generated PNG asset paths (branding, device logos, setup guides, case studies, etc.) for consistent reference throughout the frontend.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines supported languages, regions, device brands, and system types, and exports utility functions for RTL detection, temperature unit conversion, timestamp formatting, and regional device mapping.
frontend/src/lib/weather.ts: Integrates with the Open-Meteo API to fetch current and hourly weather data by coordinates, and provides a geolocation helper to retrieve the user's current position.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BestPracticesPage.tsx: A static informational page presenting best practices for energy monitoring systems, including maintenance schedules, troubleshooting tips, and performance optimization advice using accordion and card UI components.
frontend/src/pages/ComplianceSecurityPag: A compliance and security information page that displays regulatory and security details, with a print-to-PDF feature that triggers the browser print dialog and shows a toast notification on completion.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: The main dashboard page that renders a tabbed interface (Overview, Systems, Alarms, Insights, Analytics, and optionally admin tabs) and displays a personalized greeting using the caller's user profile.
An admin page for ICP Gateway domain configuration that checks accessibility of production domains, displays deployment status, and provides copy-to-clipboard utilities for ic-domains file content.
frontend/src/pages/DeviceIntegrationGuid: A page listing integration guides for supported energy monitoring devices (e.g., Emporia Vue), with collapsible setup steps, troubleshooting tips, privacy notes, and EcoToken benefits for each device.
frontend/src/pages/DiagnosticsPage.tsx: Renders a diagnostics page with tabs for smart diagnostics, regional electrical system info (voltage/frequency/plug types by continent), and documentation links with search/filter functionality.
frontend/src/pages/DomainPortfolioPage.t: Displays a domain portfolio strategy page with mock data showing availability and pricing for ecopowerhub TLD variants, along with brand protection recommendations and a notice that backend implementation is pending.
frontend/src/pages/EmailAutomationPage.t: Provides an email automation configuration UI with predefined keyword-based rules that map common support topics (e.g., Emporia connection, EcoTokens, billing) to short canned responses, with toggles to enable/disable each rule.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page featuring a full-screen hero section with a globe background, a CTA button, and sections for device setup guides (Emporia Vue, Sense Monitor, etc.) using the MarketingHeader and MarketingFooter components.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that uses Internet Identity for authentication, redirects authenticated users to the dashboard, and displays feature highlights (energy tracking, global compatibility, smart recommendations, privacy) alongside a login button.
frontend/src/pages/MarketingCampaignAsse: Displays marketing campaign assets for EcoPowerHub AI, including a detailed 60-second video ad script broken into scenes and banner ad variants with copy/download functionality.
frontend/src/pages/PartnerMarketplacePag: Renders a partner marketplace page listing affiliate programs (Sense, Emporia, Amazon, ShareASale, CJ Affiliate) with commission details, benefits, and tracking IDs.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Static privacy policy page for Eco PowerHub AI LLC covering data collection, usage, sharing, and security practices, last updated December 1, 2025.
frontend/src/pages/SupportIntegrationsPa: Displays support and integrations information by fetching manufacturer support and support boundary data from the API, showing active manufacturers and what the platform supports.
frontend/src/pages/TechSpecsPage.tsx: Shows technical specifications including a global voltage compatibility matrix, device specs for supported energy monitors, SCADA protocol support fetched from the API, and compliance standards.
frontend/src/routes/RootRoute.tsx: Minimal root route component that renders a TanStack Router Outlet as the top-level layout entry point.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines all frontend TypeScript interfaces and types mirroring the backend data structures, including SystemConfig, EnergyData, Recommendation, EVTelemetry, PricingTier, and various other domain models used throughout the app.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, secondary, sidebar, chart colors, etc.), custom border radii, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
frontend/vite-build-verify.js: A post-build verification script that checks the dist output for required PNG image assets (logos, setup guides, app images) with expected filenames and dimensions.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for the React frontend, defining manual chunk splitting for vendor libraries (React, TanStack, Radix, icons, charts, Three.js), path aliases, environment variable injection for canister/DFX prefixes, and a dev server proxy to the local ICP replica.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the EcoPowerHub AI ICP project, documenting architectural notes, known issues, and pending feature requests—primarily adding a getEnergySnapshot query method to the equipa Motoko canister.
